=== HANDOFF #24 — three changes landed, two children closed, the arbitrating harness run is IN FLIGHT ===

Written on e369 (not the session log: 558e-55ce-d9f1-4fa9 is still the write-blocked one; this
session used no session log at all rather than fight it).

--- LANDED THIS STRETCH (all three MERGED, both gates green, submitted via REST) ---
  **1302** `8ab91b3f33` — 39c1: epic parent to DC via the Epic Link + agile_rest_path='greenhopper'.
  **1303** `29f9627128` — 2b16: xfail the inbound link-delete cell. Verified ON MAIN: full reason
     text present, `strict=False`, cell body unmodified, not inverted, not deleted.
  **1305** `364c4e8f5e` — 39c1 AC4: the operator-visible signal. NEW this session.

--- CLOSED ---
  **88d9** (`--class preexisting`). All 13 ACs verified against the merged code, not its narrative.
     AC11 took its pre-authorised PLATFORM branch and is filed separately as required.
  **2b16** (`--class preexisting`). Its DESCRIPTION still carried the original 15 ACs while the
     amendment lived only in a comment — they are now reconciled: 8 criteria stand (checked), 15 are
     preserved VERBATIM as `~~RETIRED~~` records rather than checkboxes.

--- 1305, WHAT IT DOES, because the next reader will want it in one line ---
Every `set_parent` failure arm in `update_one` now writes a `bridge_alerts` entry (the channel
`record_backstop_failure` already uses) while KEEPING warn-and-continue. Three kinds:
`outbound-parent-unrepresentable` / `-rejected` / `-failed`. Fail-open. 4/4 mutations killed.
**This makes the next harness run diagnostic:** if DC is ERRORING on the parent writes and the
swallow was hiding it, an alert now appears; if no alert appears, DC returned success and lied.

--- HARNESS RUN 30834117797 (PRE-1302, main @ 25ead49f3e) — 6 failed / 52 passed, canary
    `collected=58 executed=58 skipped=0`. Verdicts recorded on 5200. TWO WERE NOT PREDICTED: ---
  * **[rebar:1a9f-50c0-e7a5-4fda]** — the DC SUB-TASK reparent appears to be accepted-and-IGNORED.
    Outbound read `fields.parent` back over RAW REST and saw the PRE-mutation parent; inbound timed
    out at 90s. A search-index lag cannot explain a direct field read, so the inbound cell's own
    "not a bridge defect" self-diagnosis is the weaker reading. **This undercuts 39c1's premise that
    the sub-task shape is the one DC accepts** — which would make 1302's Epic Link path the ONLY
    candidate, not a second one. 39c1's AC1 must NOT be ticked off the unit suite.
  * **[rebar:18a5-2bd8-3e56-4bd8]** — outbound CREATE against DC produced no binding
    (`get_jira_key` returned None). Row 1 outbound, the new cell, failing exactly where its author
    predicted. Failing STAGE (planned / dispatched / bound) not yet separated.
  * **[rebar:37e7-d751-0042-4b94]** — the DC-refuses-to-null-a-sub-task-parent platform finding,
    filed to satisfy 88d9's AC11. Its consequence is stated plainly on the ticket: the inbound
    parent clear now has NO live coverage on DC.

--- IN FLIGHT: run 30840572608 on `364c4e8f5e` ---
Dispatched only AFTER confirming `origin/main` contained 1305 — the mirror WAS stale at dispatch
time (it sat at 1303 for several minutes) and a run then would have silently excluded 1305.
This run arbitrates: 39c1's AC1 (does the Epic Link path work on DC 8.17.1 — pycontribs routes
`add_issues_to_epic` to `{agile_rest_path}/1.0/epics/{epic}/add` and some DC versions key it by epic
ID not KEY; fallback is a direct write of the discovered `Epic Link` customfield_NNNNN), whether
1a9f's accept-and-ignore reading holds, and 5200's remaining cell verdicts. **Record the run id and
WHICH PATH WORKED.**

--- WHAT REMAINS ---
 1. read run 30840572608's per-cell verdicts + the canary line
 2. close **39c1** (AC1 needs this run; AC2/AC3/AC4/AC5 are already satisfied and verified —
    AC3 confirmed by `git diff 7fc96b277 gerrit/main -- test_parent_hierarchy_guard.py` being EMPTY)
 3. close **5200** (its 18 ACs were independently verified in comment 31; the three gaps were
    repaired by 1279/1280/1283; what was outstanding was the run, not the analysis)
 4. re-run `rebar review-plan e369 --status` IMMEDIATELY before the epic close — it reads
    `stale-code` right now and re-stales every time main moves
 5. close **e369**

--- ONE OPERATIONAL NOTE ---
The review-bot's HTTP receiver was DOWN for ~40 minutes (autodeploy restart; container up, uvicorn
gone, nginx 502, `/rerun` unusable). Its background worker kept voting, which is how 1302 got
through. Once recovered, `POST /review/rerun?token=…&change=<n>` cleared the backlog for 1303/1305
in minutes. If votes stall again with no `VOTER_ERROR`, check `curl 127.0.0.1:8000/health` on the
prod host BEFORE assuming the LLM or the gate is at fault.
